}}'''Venr Kosaan''' was one of [[Careane Fransi|Careane Fransi's]] [[Warder]]s.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Venr Kosaan|Venr}}  He was also a [[Darkfriend]].{{ref||Venr}}

== Appearance ==
He was dark with touches of gray in his curly black hair and had a short beard. He was very slim and 5'10" or 178&nbsp;cm tall.

== Activities ==
He was with Careane when she traveled to [[Caemlyn]].  Inside the house on Full Moon Street Careane was exposed as being of the [[Black Ajah]].  She was subsequently killed by [[Vandene Namelle]]. Venr felt Careane die inside the house and rushed inside. He along with Careane's other two warders perished in the ensuing confrontation.{{ref||Venr}}
